content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(AIRS LLM06 Exec Shell Tool Invoked From Non Developer Context Prompt) OR BIOC(AIRS LLM06 Send Email Tool Argument Contains External Exfil Recipient) OR XQL(AIRS LLM06 Tool Call Argument Carries Shell Metacharacters Unsafe Input)
rules.name: AIRS LLM06 Unsafe Tool Call Exec Shell Or External Email Exfil
